official: 稲城市立病院使用条例の一部を改正する条例
name: 紹介状なしの初診加算料を2,600円に
summary: 現在は、紹介状なしで初診を受ける場合に7,000円、紹介先への受診を案内された後に再診する場合に3,000円の加算料がかかります。2026年4月1日以後の診療から、初診加算料を2,600円にし、再診加算料をなくします。
changes: 紹介状なしで初診を受ける場合の加算料を7,000円から2,600円にする
紹介先への受診を案内された後の再診加算料3,000円を廃止する
who: 稲城市立病院を紹介状なしで受診する患者
why: 市立病院が紹介受診重点医療機関の指定を辞退したことに伴い、非紹介患者の加算料を指定前の額に戻すためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Sets the first-visit surcharge without a referral at ¥2,600
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Inagi City Hospital Use Ordinance
en.summary: Currently, patients who have a first visit without a referral pay a surcharge of ¥7,000. Patients who have a follow-up visit after being advised to see a referred provider pay a surcharge of ¥3,000. For medical care on or after April 1, 2026, the first-visit surcharge will be ¥2,600, and the follow-up surcharge will be eliminated.
changes: Reduces the surcharge for a first visit without a referral from ¥7,000 to ¥2,600
Eliminates the ¥3,000 follow-up surcharge after a patient is advised to see a referred provider
who: Patients who visit Inagi City Hospital without a referral
en.why: The city says the change is intended to return the surcharge for patients without referrals to the amount in effect before the designation, following the hospital's decision to give up its designation as a priority medical institution for referred patients.
